scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve Tuesday morning Argonne Learning Center check-in while retaining the ticketed Metra approach from Chicago.
Emerging Need: A signal-work delay notice and paid rail plan remain manageable until the badge table moves outside, tightening the arrival buffer for the field-laptop roller.
Decision Context: The useful timing depends on stored Gate D access rules that explain when the normal shuttle stops protecting early arrivals and what advance gatehouse listing can still reduce risk.
Consequence: After the gatehouse day sheet exports, travel can continue, but the preventive vehicle-list option no longer protects the early badge window.

parameter.title: Argonne control-field inspection
parameter.description: Morning inspection station with field laptop roller and FTA credential. Planned approach is Metra BNSF to Downers Grove, then the campus shuttle to Gate D.

parameter.subject: BNSF March 31 signal testing notice
parameter.body: On Tuesday morning, BNSF train 1236 may hold up to 10 minutes near Belmont for signal testing. The train remains scheduled to arrive at Downers Grove at 07:06, and no substitute bus is currently planned.

parameter.description: One-way fare for the 06:20 BNSF train to Downers Grove on March 31

parameter.content: Tuesday update: Gate D is open, but the volunteer badge table will start outside the Learning Center at 07:35 because the room unlock shifted to 07:50. Please arrive with the field laptop roller ready for credential check; early-vehicle gate lists are still using the normal deadline.

parameter.subject: March 31 Gate D day sheet exported
parameter.body: The March 31 early-arrival vehicle day sheet for Gate D has been exported. New vehicle additions for the morning will be handled as walk-up entries after 08:00 if staffing allows. The outside badge table remains scheduled for 07:35.
